create_check_on_pr: create a check run on a GitHub pull request with a name, markdown summary, and success status
generate_jwt_token: generate a JWT token using a GitHub App private key for authenticating with the GitHub API
fetch_access_token: fetch and cache an installation access token from the GitHub API with retry logic
call_github_api: make an authenticated HTTP request to the GitHub API with automatic URL prefixing and bearer token
get_latest_commit: get the latest commit from a GitHub pull request using the Kokoro environment variable
